scripts.dev: vite build --mode dev && vite build --mode dev --config vite.icons.config.js && concurrently "npm run serve:dist" "npm run build:watch"
scripts.build:watch: concurrently "vite build --watch --mode dev" "vite build --watch --mode dev --config vite.icons.config.js"
scripts.build:prod: tsc && rm -rf dist && vite build --mode prod && vite build --mode prod --config vite.icons.config.js
